title: How semiconductors powered South Korea’s $1tr export milestone
caption:
Surging demand for high-bandwidth memory chips has pushed South Korea past the one-trillion-dollar export milestone. By vertically stacking silicon to accelerate AI processing, domestic manufacturers captured dominant global market share.
